summary: Credit Acceptance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $600.0 million asset-backed non-recourse secured financing. The company conveyed consumer loans worth approximately $750.2 million to a wholly owned SPE, Credit Acceptance Funding LLC 2026-2, which transferred them to a trust that issued three classes of notes (A: $319.88M, B: $117.3M, C: $162.82M) with interest rates of 5.01%, 5.29%, and 5.51%. The financing revolves for 24 months, then amortizes, and funds will repay higher-cost debt and general corporate purposes. This is a routine debt financing, not a special situation.
